records.question: Compare revenue for January to August 2017 against the same period in 2018.
records.raw:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-09-01' THEN p.total_payment ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2017,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01' THEN p.total_payment ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2018,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01' THEN p.total_payment ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-09-01' THEN p.total_payment ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_difference
FROM orders o
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
) p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01';

records.question: What share of revenue comes from customers who ordered more than once?
records.raw:
WITH order_rev AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_stats AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, SUM(revenue) AS total_rev
  FROM order_rev
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders > 1 THEN total_rev ELSE 0 END) / SUM(total_rev) AS share_repeat_customer_revenue
FROM customer_stats;

records.question: What was the month-on-month revenue growth rate through 2017?
records.raw:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2016-12-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS growth_rate
FROM monthly_revenue
WHERE month >= DATE '2017-01-01'
ORDER BY month;

records.question: What share of total revenue do the ten largest sellers account for?
records.raw:
WITH seller_revenue AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
total_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total
  FROM seller_revenue
),
top10_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS top10
  FROM (
    SELECT revenue
    FROM seller_revenue
    ORDER BY revenue DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t
)
SELECT top10 / total AS share
FROM top10_revenue, total_revenue;
